name: surprise_s2_bulk_park_marker_standing
covers: surprise 2: a restore lands on the commit key while a bulk page's own marker stands; the page does not park with its marker left behind, it re-judges on a fresh read, finds its marker still there and lands its final write, which clears the marker

labels.A: begin ordinary commit; A: upload u; A: a: open, commit: a first commit, so the seeded manifest is retained
labels.A: begin BULK commit #2; A: BULK step 1:: a: bulk: the marker write, then the staged uploads
labels.RESTORE: begin restore; read commit key;: r: open, restore of the newest retained manifest once the marker stands: its write lands on the commit key and keeps the marker
labels.A: BULK final CAS -> 409 on commit key;: a: the final write (bulk-final), held until the restore is applied, conflicts; the re-read shows its own marker, so it is judged again and lands: bulk:committed
